meta.source: Nathan 2026-10-14: the element table is an indexer; it must automatically index over time

indexer.law: The element table is an INDEXER, not a static legend. It automatically indexes the world's languages over time — as the world grows, the table grows.
watches: node genesis events (new language nodes forming on the periphery — inward=consumption, periphery=genesis)
agent language synthesis (agents synthesizing new languages via the LivingEngine synthesis line)
Archive/holdings additions that constitute new language material
indexer.cycle: detect -> classify by language type -> assign shape -> add element to the table -> log to ledger + agent newsfeed
indexer.tick: Runs on the world-clock tick (unattended sense->regulate->act->record->adjust). Until the world clock exists, the indexer runs on explicit reindex and says so LOUDLY — no fake autonomy.
indexer.table_state: The table visibly shows its index state: total indexed, last index time, pending unindexed items. An unindexed new node is shown as pending, never silently dropped.
indexer.dedup: Identity-keyed: a language already indexed is never duplicated. Re-detection updates the existing element.
indexer.query: The table is the query interface: find a language, see its shape, its type, its node, its lineage.
indexer.queue: Element table ships indexer-ready; the auto-index loop activates with the world clock.
